description:
Register an https URL that is told about the events you choose, signed with a secret shown only in this reply. At most 5 endpoints.
Use for: being told when something happens, for example a new application or message, instead of asking again and again.
Not for: seeing the endpoints you have (list_webhook_endpoints); checking an endpoint receives events (test_webhook_endpoint).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: create_webhook_endpoint({"url":"https://hooks.example.com/rentahuman","events":["application.submitted","message.received"],"description":"Main agent"})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: endpoint_limit_reached; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

description.description: Your own note to tell endpoints apart.

events.description: Event names from the allowed list. Send ["*"] for every event.

url.description: Your https URL that receives the events. It must reach a public address.

name: create_webhook_endpoint

consecutiveFailures.description: Failed deliveries in a row since the last success, test events included.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

description.description: Your own note. Left out when none was given.

disabledAt.description: When it was switched off. Left out while it is on.

disabledReason.description: Why it was switched off. Left out while it is on.

events.description: Event names this endpoint receives, for example application.submitted or message.received. ["*"] means every event.

isEnabled.description: True while this endpoint receives events. Left out (false) when disabled after repeated failed deliveries. Delete it and create it again to receive events.

lastFailureAt.description: Last failed delivery. Left out when none failed.

lastSuccessAt.description: Last delivery your URL accepted. Left out before the first.

secret.description: The signing secret of this endpoint. It is shown only in this reply: store it now to check the signature of each event.

title: Create a webhook endpoint
